Title: Submitting a changed customer contact name locks the form
Step Action: Make sure no pending customer update exists, then open the customer details page.
Step Expected: The customer details form is editable.

Step Action: Type a unique value in Contact Name and tab out of the box.

Step Expected: Contact Name and the other fields are disabled.

Title: An admin declines a pending customer update and the customer can edit again
Step Action: Submit a changed Contact Name as the customer.
As admin open /Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx and find the QAL/0432 row.

Step Expected: A message "Customer updates declined successfully" is shown and the list reopens.

Step Action: As the customer open the details page again.

Step Expected: It shows the original value, not the submitted one.

Title: An admin approves a pending customer update that changes nothing
Step Action: Submit the unchanged Contact Name as the customer (focus out enables the button).
As admin open /Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx and find the QAL/0432 row.

Step Expected: The update is applied and the list reopens.

Step Action: As the customer open the details page again.

Step Expected: It still shows the original value.
